criteria.requirement: Repair entry-point loading to count and associate a distribution only after register actually returns the real registered plugin name. Introduce register_entrypoint(plugin,name,distribution) for the same verified commit path, supporting a subclass renaming or rejecting registration and the existing None-plugin policy. Never record an unloaded/rejected/blocked name, fabricate success from an unrelated already-registered object, or leave list_plugin_distributions raising KeyError. Preserve success order, metadata identity, existing load exceptions and normal unregister distribution cleanup. Tests patch metadata with local synthetic entry points, no actual discovery imports/network.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
